capability_statement: AOF can now represent a real GitHub read as governed runtime work with adapter/resource refs, observed outputs, no-write boundary, decision, evidence refs, and audit result.
before_state: The operator could see GitHub-grounded judgment, but the external provider read was still mostly a one-off observation artifact.
after_state: AOF records the provider read as an integration artifact and verifies it with provider-read-integration-audit.
scenario: Ask AOF to inspect the GitHub repo; inspect the provider read integration record and audit to confirm what was read and that no write was authorized.
five_minute_demo: Open TASK-133-github-provider-read-integration.json and provider-read-integration-audit.json; confirm provider, adapter, observed objects, decision, and no-write boundary.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Removes manual reconstruction of which gh commands were read-only and which provider outputs informed the release decision.
cognitive_load_removed: The operator no longer needs to infer whether a GitHub read was governed, persisted, or accidentally write-capable.

capability_matrix.before: provider read was a one-off observation
capability_matrix.after: provider read is a governed runtime integration with audit coverage
capability_matrix.user_value: operator can inspect provider output and no-write boundary in one evidence path

not_proven: This does not prove provider semantic truth, GitHub write safety, credential safety, production automation, market value, productivity gain, or broad adoption.
